policy: Only reviewed text producers with exact widget FontObjects are checked. Source changes invalidate the whole mapping, including aliases, callbacks and font overrides. Review source and callers before updating sha256. Unlisted dynamic text, template-owned fonts and consumer helper arguments have no coverage claim. Empty bindings record reviewed exclusions, not glyph coverage.

producers.review: Read all of Tracker.lua, Tracker.xml and ForeverCore TrackerSection.Create, UpdateText and TrackerLine.SetInteractive. Confirmed pinned client Blizzard_ObjectiveTrackerModule.xml: ObjectiveTrackerModuleTemplate Header inherits ObjectiveTrackerModuleHeaderTemplate, whose Text uses ObjectiveTrackerHeaderFont. Blizzard_ObjectiveTrackerBlock.xml HeaderText uses ObjectiveTrackerLineFont; Blizzard_ObjectiveTrackerShared.xml ObjectiveTrackerLineTemplate Text uses ObjectiveTrackerLineFont, inherited without overrides by ShortestPathForeverTrackerLineTemplate. Bound every local phrase sent to section headers, block headers and rows, including Journey  %s · %s from #838. RefreshBlockText preserves these widgets. Client tracker text-size changes and optional Kaliels font overrides are outside the pinned native-font coverage. Menus, chat, tooltips and dynamic text from JourneyInfo, DockTitle, and DepartureText are excluded.

Read Tracker.xml and its Tracker.lua LINE_TEMPLATE, LayoutContents and RefreshBlockText callers. ShortestPathForeverTrackerLineTemplate inherits ObjectiveTrackerLineTemplate without a font override; pinned Blizzard_ObjectiveTrackerShared.xml gives both Text and Dash ObjectiveTrackerLineFont. TrackerSection.Create passes this line template to the module; TrackerLine.SetInteractive changes mouse scripts only. XML declares no locale phrase or addon runtime text, so bindings live with the phrases in Tracker.lua. Dynamic row text and client QUEST_DASH are excluded.

Read Page, Checkbox, Scale, Dropdown and Saving and their registration calls. Settings rows, index buttons and option labels delegate to Blizzard secure initializers; this file creates no FontString and establishes no explicit FontObject. Minimap button text, tooltip text, chat output and helper arguments are excluded rather than assigned an assumed settings font. Reviewed #1094: the Tracker heading's Attach to quest tracker row is ForeverCore.SettingsSections.RegisterTrackerAttach, a core-owned initializer, registered only when the running core has it (an older adopted standalone does not); excluded with the other settings fonts. Reviewed #1142: the journeyHint row is one more Checkbox helper call, a Blizzard secure initializer with no FontString or FontObject of its own.

Read Register and every rows builder call. All phrases are helper arguments to Settings.lua builders and Blizzard settings initializers, with no explicit FontObject in this producer. Tooltip descriptions and dynamic choice labels have no coverage claim.

Read dock, service and portal pin creation and tooltip callbacks. Map.xml defines textures without label FontStrings; localized destination, landing and direction phrases flow into tooltips or helper results, as does the journey click hint (ns.AddJourneyClickHint). Tooltip fonts belong to their templates, menu fonts are not established here, and dynamic location names are excluded.

Read Number creation and SetStop/tooltip paths. Number explicitly uses GameFontNormal but displays a dynamic stop number, not a locale phrase. The time-distance phrase, stop descriptions and clear hints are tooltip text owned by the tooltip template; none is bound to Number.

Read Create, ArrowLabel, distance updates, arrival labels, progress and cast prompt. MoverHint uses GameFontHighlightSmall and Distance uses GameFontNormal, including the formatted time-distance phrase. No later font override occurs. Dynamic objective lines, arrival titles, route titles and actions from helpers are excluded; this review does not claim coverage for their inserted text.

producers.review: Read frame construction, cardinal tick labels, mover hint and RenderTime. Cardinal labels use GameFontNormalMed3 and MoverHint uses GameFontHighlightSmall, with no later font override. Distance and time are dynamic helper output and marker titles/tooltips have no coverage claim.

producers.review: Read Text, Build and refresh: help and status are created by Text with GameFontHighlight; messages and formatted progress/order phrases reach status without font overrides. SharedButtonSmallTemplate buttons and row labels, PortraitFrameTemplate title, tooltip text and dynamic stop names are excluded because this producer does not establish their font objects.
